title: AI primer
summary: Most AI products are built around a conversation between a model and a person. TypeSafe starts from a different bet: large-scale automation will be dominated by AI-to-AI and AI-to-software interactions, so the machine interface matters more

title: System One
summary: System One models are a class of AI models built to make fast, structured decisions that software can use directly. A System One model evaluates a [state](/concepts/state) and returns typed answers and probabilities.
